purpose: Detect information that would have improved a past decision or analysis, preserve the discovery episode as hypothesis-generation only, acquire/backfill evidence where safely sourceable, and validate incremental value prospectively before any possible promotion.
anti_hindsight_rules: The episode that generated the gap may establish relevance and source requirements but can never count as validation evidence.
Backfilled observations must have source-time provenance and must not use reconstructed point-in-time order-book state that was never archived.
If reliable backfill is impossible, the lane starts prospectively with UNKNOWN history.
A candidate may not alter a market rule, threshold, weight, canonical state or portfolio action during validation.
Incremental value must be measured against the information set that was actually available at the decision time.
Correlated duplicate sensors should be rejected or retained research-only even when individually predictive.
Single-episode success is insufficient for promotion review.
